assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease.
CPT 93271 cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to capture arrhythmic activity during symptomatic periods.
This study will assist in confirming the diagnosis of atrial fibrillation and guiding appropriate rate or rhythm control management.
